title: The saxophone Bechet gave Lewis
summary: Bechet gave Lewis a soprano saxophone about two years earlier, nearly two years before he died. It was originally gold-plated and had been left in this country; Lewis plays a few notes.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Yeah, that's right. I was going to ask about a saxophone. We had that letter that you were kind enough to let us copy this afternoon when he gave you the saxophone. That was about two years ago, you say?
Almost two years before he died, then, too, or a year and a half.
Just a straight model. Was his ever gold, and you have it gold-plated, I notice now.
It was. It was originally gold-plated. The repairman told me it had been gold-plated. Of course, there wasn't much gold left on it. When I got it, Sidney had left it in this country for some time.
Do you want to play a few notes, just so we can see where you have Sidney's sax here?
